notes: Replaces four 27x24 multipliers with four shared 25x24 multipliers, targeting at most 16 DSP48E1s instead of the measured 24. Storage retains three fractional bits in 26-bit signed words. Multiplier operands represent at most 32 input samples: their magnitude is below 1.483 million, safely inside the 25-bit operand range of +/-2.097152 million at this scale. Full results fit the storage range of +/-4.194304 million. Twiddles retain 22 fractional bits. Rounding is nearest, ties toward positive infinity. The first two stages are exact; propagating complex coefficient and rounding errors through the remaining stages bounds each final component's error below 2.9 units, including integer rounding, satisfying both per-field limits. Forward unnormalized FFT, natural input/output order; 192 reused butterflies, latency 392, supported initiation interval 400. Reset cancels work without clearing sample memories. Revised mapping and 200 MHz timing have not been measured; no tools were invoked.
